race.comment: RISKY WHISKY (2) displayed plenty of early toe and went on to score dominantly over 900m at this track. Likely to push forward from the wide draw. Well placed and there is no reason he cannot salute with gun hoop in Loy sticking. BRIAL ROSE (5) scored at her most recent appearance, getting home comfortably over this trip at Wagga. That continued the solid form this campaign, with two wins from four outings. Top chance again. MARINE GIRL (9) returns for the sharp Nick Olive camp and is a noted fresh performer. Has enough pace to offset the wide draw and will get every chance with Keatings piloting. BARGINO (12) has mixed his form since resuming but boasts solid peaks and has a good record on his home track. Can't underestimate.
